name: muktoconnect
displayName: MuktoConnect — Custom AI Providers for Copilot Chat
description: Connect custom AI providers and models to GitHub Copilot Chat: MuktoDwar local gateway, Kilo Gateway, OpenCode Console / Zen and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — with automatic retry and model fallback.

muktoconnect.muktodwar.baseUrl.description: MuktoDwar gateway base URL (loopback only). Chat requests go to <baseUrl>/chat/completions.

muktoconnect.muktodwar.modelsUrl.description: Model list URL for MuktoDwar. Leave empty to use <baseUrl>/models.

muktoconnect.muktodwar.modelIds.description: Model IDs always exposed for MuktoDwar. The default alias resolves to any free model you allowlisted.

muktoconnect.muktodwar.fallbackModels.description: Optional ordered fallback chain when the selected MuktoDwar model fails. Eligible models from other configured providers are added automatically; providers without required credentials or a valid base URL are skipped.

muktoconnect.kilo.baseUrl.description: M-Kilo OpenAI-compatible base URL. Chat requests go to <baseUrl>/chat/completions.

muktoconnect.kilo.modelsUrl.description: Model list URL for Kilo Gateway. Leave empty to use <baseUrl>/models.

muktoconnect.kilo.modelIds.description: Extra model IDs to expose for M-Kilo (always listed, even when the models endpoint is unreachable).

muktoconnect.kilo.fallbackModels.description: Optional ordered fallback chain when the selected M-Kilo model fails. Eligible models from other configured providers are added automatically; providers without required credentials or a valid base URL are skipped.

muktoconnect.opencode.baseUrl.description: M-OpenCode OpenAI-compatible base URL. Chat requests go to <baseUrl>/chat/completions.

muktoconnect.opencode.modelsUrl.description: Model list URL for M-OpenCode (differs from the chat base URL). Leave empty to use <baseUrl>/models.

muktoconnect.opencode.modelIds.description: Extra model IDs to expose for M-OpenCode.

muktoconnect.opencode.fallbackModels.description: Optional ordered fallback chain when the selected M-OpenCode model fails. Eligible models from other configured providers are added automatically; providers without required credentials or a valid base URL are skipped.

muktoconnect.custom.baseUrl.description: Base URL of your OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1). Required for the Custom provider.

muktoconnect.custom.modelsUrl.description: Model list URL for the custom provider. Leave empty to use <baseUrl>/models.

muktoconnect.custom.modelIds.description: Model IDs to expose for the custom provider.

muktoconnect.custom.fallbackModels.description: Optional ordered fallback chain when the selected custom model fails. Eligible models from other configured providers are added automatically; providers without required credentials or a valid base URL are skipped.

muktoconnect.retry.maxAttempts.description: Attempts per model on retryable failures (network errors, 408/409/425/429/5xx) before moving to the next fallback model.

muktoconnect.retry.baseDelayMs.description: Base delay for exponential backoff between retries: doubles each attempt plus jitter.

muktoconnect.retry.autoSwitch.description: After a successful automatic switch, keep using the promoted model for later requests until it fails.

muktoconnect.request.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for a single attempt against a model endpoint.

muktoconnect.retry.autoContinue.description: After a text-only streamed response is interrupted, make one continuation request using the partial answer as context. Tool-call partials are never auto-continued.

muktoconnect.diagnostics.greetingRespons.description: Opt-in diagnostic: log request metadata and up to 500 characters of the response only for simple hi/hello/hey messages. Disable after testing.
